p: LORD called unto Moses: By this Moses declares that he taught nothing to the people but that which he received from God.
cattle: So they could offer of no other sort, but of those who were commanded.
tabernacle of the congregation before the: Meaning, within the court of the tabernacle.
he shall kill the bullock before: A priest of the Levites.
altar that is by the door: Of the burnt offering, Ex 27:1.
unto the LORD: Or a savour of rest, which pacifies the anger of the Lord.
And he shall kill it on: Read Le 1:5.
before the LORD: Before the altar of the Lord.
wring off his head: The Hebrew word signifies to pinch off with the nail.
east part: On the side of the court gate in the pans which stood with ashes; Ex 27:3.
